page.notes: The diagram's lines run between boxes: Affirmatio and Negatio cross to Verum/Falsum, and Amor and Odium & fuga cross to Bonum/Malum; the outline levels are read from the braces. The ornamental border line between the diagram and the chapter heading is not transcribed. The Greek or spacing in the header row ("Quo" and "1. 2.") is approximate. The right edge shows the neighbouring page, which is excluded. Possible printing errors: "Ego add erem" is printed as a split word; "pra-cticus" is set with a ligature that may be misread.
